👋 Welcome to Soyda

A clean digital space for projects, ideas, and creative exploration.

🚀 What This Space Is For

This is my personal playground where I document my learning journey, share insights, and build things I care about.

  • Projects — Side projects, experiments, and open source contributions
  • Notes — Technical documentation, tutorials, and personal musings
  • Ideas — Brainstorms, sketches, and half-baked concepts

💻 Tech Stack

Built with simplicity in mind:

  • Static Site — Fast, secure, and easy to deploy
  • GitHub Pages — Free hosting with built-in CI/CD
  • Jekyll — The world’s fastest website builder
  • Minimal — No bloat, just content

🎯 Why This Approach?

“Make it simple first. Complicate it later if you need to.”

Static sites are:

  • ✅ Blazing fast (no server-side processing)
  • ✅ Secure by default (no database, no auth to hack)
  • ✅ Easy to scale (just throw more bandwidth at it)
  • ✅ Free to host (GitHub Pages + Netlify + Vercel all work)

📬 Get in Touch

Feel free to explore, fork, and contribute!
